films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's stop-motion epic makes the Fleece the prize of the voyage — the golden hide on the oak as cinema's most famous Argonaut trophy.

popCulture.title: Golden Fleece
popCulture.description: The ram that saved Phrixus, the Hellespont named for Helle's fall, and the Colchian prize that launches Jason's quest — still Western myth's signature treasure.

popCulture.title: Order of the Golden Fleece
popCulture.creator: Philip the Good
popCulture.description: Burgundy's knightly order took the Fleece as its emblem — a medieval chivalric afterlife for Phrixus' ram and Jason's prize.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius' Hellenistic epic still frames the Fleece as the voyage's goal — Colchis, the sleepless dragon, and the hide that justifies every labour.

popCulture.title: Phrixus
popCulture.description: The Boeotian prince who rode the golden ram to Colchis and hung its fleece for Aeetes — the origin myth behind every Argonaut retelling.
